title: Vikram and Betal: The Careful Listener

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a boy who talks too much.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a boy who did not listen carefully.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The boy did not listen to the teacher and made mistakes.
scenes.image_prompt: boy ignoring teacher and making mistakes cartoon

scenes.text: Another student listened and completed the task correctly.
scenes.image_prompt: student listening carefully and working cartoon

scenes.text: The teacher explained the importance of listening.
scenes.image_prompt: teacher explaining to sad boy cartoon

scenes.text: The boy decided to listen more. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: boy nodding and learning lesson cartoon

story: A boy who did not listen made mistakes, while another succeeded by listening carefully. Vikram said listening leads to success.
